resources.string: Each invitation calls one traveller: Common 78%, Rare 20%, Epic 2%. You are sure to meet a Rare within your first 8 free calls, and an Epic at the latest every 80 calls. A traveller you already know becomes fragments of that hero, used for stars. Legendary heroes never answer a call: they are earned through vigils at the Stone Circle (journal, Legends). Heroes you have not met stay hidden.
A route completed with three stars can be gathered instantly. Spend food to prepare the expedition, receive normal repeat loot and help village construction. New routes still require exploration.
The best finished inn makes one invitation every 24 hours (rank 1), 19 h 12 (rank 2) or 16 hours (rank 3), even while you are away. Village work adds more, twice a day at most: %1$d / 400.
An orchard keeper who raises a living shield. His skills also restore the most wounded ally, making him a forgiving first-line guardian.
A watchtower scout who marks dangerous foes. Her skills weaken one enemy, or three with her ultimate, reducing their attack.
The village infirmary’s travelling apothecary. She heals and removes poison, weakness and stuns from the most wounded ally; her ultimate cleanses the whole team.
A woodland singer who knows every planting song. Her inspiration also gives an extra heal to the most wounded ally.
A lantern-bearing gatekeeper. His skills add shields to both front-line allies, protecting a fragile partner as well as himself.
A crossbow maker who tests every bolt. His skills strike again at the weakest enemy below 35% health.
A keeper of winter seeds. Her magic briefly freezes one enemy, or three with her ultimate, interrupting their attacks.
A dusk courier who slips past the front line. Her skills also weaken enemy attacks, buying time for village healers.
A smith whose hammer keeps marching time. His inspiring songs also shield both front-line allies.
A fencing teacher from the reed beds. Each skill restores a little health to the most wounded ally, keeping long encounters manageable.
A star gardener who calls little celestial companions. Her summons are backed by shields for the front line.
A discreet locksmith who protects caravan routes. Her skills strike again at a foe below 35% health, finishing wounded enemies behind the line.
A millwright who builds ingenious traps. Alongside her machinery, her skills weaken enemy attacks.
A sworn defender of the market road. His skills cleanse the most wounded ally; his ultimate removes poison, weakness and stuns from the entire team.
A kiln keeper who turns sparks into spells. Her fire also weakens the enemy, reducing pressure on the village guard.
A botanist whose herbarium never closes. Her healing skills remove poison, weakness and stuns; her ultimate cleanses all allies.
An observatory inventor with a clockwork frost lens. Her skills briefly freeze foes in addition to stunning them with machinery.
A forge keeper who awakens little metal guardians. Every summon also brings shields to both front-line allies.
The guardian of the oldest forest path. His arrows strike again at a foe below 35% health; combine him with area damage to finish weakened groups.
A singer whose dawn chorus clears the air. Her skills cleanse the most wounded ally; her ultimate frees the whole team from poison, weakness and stuns.
The living cornerstone of the village walls. His shields are accompanied by a small heal for the most wounded ally.
An ancient shepherd of woodland spirits. His summons also restore the most wounded ally, supporting the team in long fights.
An astronomer who catches falling stars in winter glass. Her skills freeze one enemy; her ultimate freezes three.
A master smith who forged his own duelling blade. His skills strike again at the weakest foe below 35% health.
